sourceTitle: Thomas Otway The Best Plays of the Old Dramatists
description: "The Best Plays of the Old Dramatists: Thomas Otway" is a collection of plays written in the late 19th century, featuring the works of the playwright Thomas Otway, edited by Havelock Ellis. This anthology offers a glimpse into the dramatic artistry of Otway, whose works are known for their emotional intensity and exploration of human passions.
